newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 950 million yuan from 1.777 billion yuan last Friday with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said trading was dull on Monday with both banks and non-banking financial institutions staying on the sidelines amid market uncertainties.
Rumours that the central bank will shortly cut bank reserve ratios continued to dominate the market, they said.
"The rumours made financial institutions reluctant to build positions," said one trader.
Traders said they expected the rates to move narrowly in slow trading in the next few days.
